column1: # Tier A (cochlear curated, PROXY) -- ONE ROW PER TF. Every row needs a PMID or DOI and an evidence tier, or the build
# script DROPS it. expected_ko_sign: +1 = knockout expected to move the network toward aging (loss of a maintenance
# factor); -1 = knockout expected to oppose aging. Hearing-loss / hair-cell-loss phenotypes are a proxy for this, not
# aging itself.  evidence_tier: e.g. KO_mouse_phenotype | conditional_KO | human_genetics | in_vitro.
